name: Law and Public Health Minor
intro: The Minor in Law and Public Health offers an interdisciplinary foundation for understanding how legal systems shape health services, health behaviors, and population health outcomes. Students examine domestic and global health law, ethics, regulation, and health systems, with particular attention to health equity, patient rights, and the social determinants of health.
